rows.en: ＊Sakaki＊＠００９＿０２０This exam is "Wildlife Capture."￥Use a tranquilizer gun to catch￥a creature, then examine it.＝＠００９＿０２１This time, it's a hologram￥exercise, but...＝＠００９＿０２２on a real unknown planet,￥there's no telling what might￥live there.
＊Sakaki＊＠００９＿０２３Hologram or not, don't let your￥guard down. Stay alert.
